title: La Paz, the aquarium of the world
lede: Jacques Cousteau's name for the Sea of Cortez. A narrow gulf that concentrates what other oceans spread across thousands of miles — cold upwellings, deserted islands, and a density of marine life that still surprises people who've sailed it for years. Every Eagle Ray expedition departs from here.
heroImageAlt: Sea lion resting near Los Islotes, La Paz
wildlifeIntro: Sightings are never guaranteed — these are wild animals in open water. What we can offer is the season, the place, and the odds.

species.name: Whale sharks
species.note: Juveniles feeding right in the bay. You snorkel alongside them, no scuba gear needed.
species.imageAlt: Whale shark feeding near the surface

species.name: Mobula rays
species.note: Schools of hundreds leaping clear of the water. You hear them before you see them.
species.imageAlt: Mobula rays leaping from the water

species.name: Sea lions — Los Islotes
species.note: A permanent colony. The juveniles dive with you, not the other way around.

species.name: Dolphins
species.note: They show up at the bow while under sail. We don't look for them — they find us.

species.name: Manta rays
species.note: Over reef pinnacles and sandy bottoms, usually during the morning dive.

species.name: Humpback whales
species.note: Seasonal migration, observed from the boat at the distance regulation requires.

wildlifeFootnote: Espíritu Santo is a protected national park and part of the UNESCO World Heritage Site "Islands and Protected Areas of the Gulf of California." We anchor only at authorized buoys, and sightings follow the distances and timing set by regulation.
destinationsTitle: Three places, all reachable in a day

destinations.name: Espíritu Santo
destinations.description: A protected island national park ten miles out. Home to the Los Islotes sea lion colony and mangrove channels we kayak at low tide.

destinations.name: Balandra
destinations.description: One of the most photographed bays on the gulf. Shallow turquoise water and easy reef snorkeling, usually empty by early evening.

destinations.name: La Ventana
destinations.description: An hour from La Paz, on the other side of the peninsula. The same north wind that keeps the bay flat turns into one of Baja's most reliable kite spots.
